name: Gomamon
main_effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] Trash any 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, this Digimon can't be blocked for the turn.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] When this Digimon would be deleted, you may play 1 [Gomamon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
